<MethodEndpoint
  method={"get"}
  path={"/management/teams"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



FindAll handles HTTP GET requests to retrieve team records with optional filtering and pagination.
It supports filtering by either "correlation_id" or "company_group_id" query parameters, but only one at a time.
If both filters are provided, it returns a 400 Bad Request error.
Pagination is controlled via "page" and "page_size" query parameters, with defaults and limits applied.
Returns a JSON response containing the paginated teams or an error message.
